description: This file defines the `EditView` class in PHP, used in the SuiteCRM project to manage the editing interface for modules. It handles template processing and display logic, including assigning various system variables and rendering templates with Smarty.

classes.name: EditView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering and processing the edit view templates within SuiteCRM. It manages template assignments and display functions, integrating system information and localization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the module, template, and Smarty object used for rendering.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Prepares the template by assigning system variables and localization strings to the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders and returns the processed template as HTML.
